info.name: Amazon Redshift - G E T_ Get Reserved Node Exchange Configuration Options

params.name: ActionType
params.description: The action type of the reserved-node configuration. The action type can be an exchange initiated from either a snapshot or a resize.

params.name: ClusterIdentifier
params.description: The identifier for the cluster that is the source for a reserved-node exchange.

params.name: SnapshotIdentifier
params.description: The identifier for the snapshot that is the source for the reserved-node exchange.

params.name: MaxRecords
params.description: The maximum number of response records to return in each call. If the number of remaining response records exceeds the specified MaxRecords value, a value is returned in a Marker field of the response. You can retrieve the next set of records by retrying the command with the returned marker value.

params.name: Marker
params.description: An optional pagination token provided by a previous GetReservedNodeExchangeConfigurationOptions request. If this parameter is specified, the response includes only records beyond the marker, up to the value specified by the MaxRecords parameter. You can retrieve the next set of response records by providing the returned marker value in the Marker parameter and retrying the request.

items.docs: Gets the configuration options for the reserved-node exchange. These options include information about the source reserved node and target reserved node offering. Details include the node type, the price, the node count, and the offering type.
